name: Mimasaka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mimasaka city emblem in blue, green and red: a blue arc above a green stylised mountain with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Mimasaka, a city in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 June 2005.

features.role: Mimasaka city emblem — a blue arc above a green stylised mountain with a red disc
